0022600005.text: Golden State opens its 2026-27 season at the Los Angeles Lakers, with both teams yet to play this season, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Warriors a 35% chance to win. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed reason), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee), and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) are day-to-day game-time decisions. The Lakers have Adou Thiero, Bronny James, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton, Dalton Knecht, and Jarred Vanderbilt listed as day-to-day game-time decisions, and the Warriors lost 1-3 to Los Angeles in the 2025-26 season series, including a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
